description:
He killed a god. It cost him everything he remembered — including her.
Now the woman he lost is alive… and only one of them remembers the other.

THE RUST SAINT — PART 2
Silas Crane rides again. The bounty on his head says THE MAN WHO KILLED A GOD, and every hunter in the wastes wants to collect — including the most dangerous of them all, the Lantern Widow. But when word comes that a woman was dug alive out of the god's fallen rib, Silas has one road left: east, past the Choir, past the storm, and into the dead god itself.

Every man his brass arm kills costs him a memory. How much is he willing to forget to bring her home?

▶ Watch PART 1 first: https://youtu.be/Arq1M1TP4PI?si=hNk4nga0RhW8AZbj

A cinematic fantasy western in three chapters:
I. The Lantern Widow
II. The Price of a Name
III. Inside the God

If you enjoyed the ride, leave a like and tell me in the comments: should Silas ride again?
